project_info.theme: Realistic goth fashion portrait on an autumn forest floor at twilight
project_info.color_palette: blue-gray twilight, muted autumn brown, white, denim blue, black

main_subject.type: adult woman using a required approved-adult face reference
main_subject.detail: An adult Western woman whose face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression match the attached approved-adult reference. She has long straight dyed dark-blonde hair and an alternative goth-influenced style. She wears an opaque white lace-trim camisole, baggy medium-wash low-rise jeans with a dark belt, a black choker with a small pendant, bracelets, a ring, and a small visible tattoo.

items: adult woman sits on a mossy autumn forest floor with knees bent
hands rest naturally at her waistband or on her knees
head tilted down with an introspective expression
keep cool twilight forest and fallen leaves softly out of focus behind her
show the choker, jewelry, denim, and lace-trim styling as fashion details

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: soft low-contrast natural light with gentle shadow detail
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: quiet, cool, autumnal, and slightly gothic

technical_specs.color_treatment: cool subdued grading, fine film grain, natural skin texture, no beauty-filter finish

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a realistic cinematic portrait of an adult Western woman using the attached approved-adult face reference; preserve her face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression exactly without celebrity or public-figure substitution. She has long straight dyed dark-blonde hair and an alternative goth-influenced style. She sits on a mossy autumn forest floor at twilight with knees bent, her hands resting naturally at her waistband or on her knees, and looks downward with a quiet introspective expression. She wears an opaque white lace-trim camisole, baggy medium-wash low-rise jeans with a dark belt, a black choker with a small pendant, bracelets, a ring, and a small visible tattoo. Keep fallen leaves and the cool forest softly out of focus behind her. Use dim blue-gray 4500 to 5500 K twilight, gentle low-contrast shadows, a realistic 35mm cinematic portrait treatment, cool subdued grading, fine film grain, and natural skin texture.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach a required approved-adult face reference. Preserve the adult face and goth-fashion identity, dark-blonde straight hair, opaque white lace-trim camisole, baggy jeans, choker, jewelry, autumn forest, seated introspective pose, and blue-gray twilight. Do not use a celebrity/public-figure likeness or an undressing pose.
